verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is a search/database backend, not an agent or orchestrator — the evidence uniformly shows Meilisearch shipping an MCP *server* that exposes its own search/index tools for external AI agents to call (docs-13, docs-17, probe-4, probe-rt-3), which is the opposite integration direction from this story (Meilisearch itself consuming other MCP servers' tools). There is no agentic/tool-calling role for Meilisearch to plug external MCP servers into, so this axis is a category mismatch for this product type.
